rules.quote: Abbreviations should be defined at first mention
rules.requirement: Define abbreviations on first use.

rules.quote: The abstract should not contain any undefined abbreviations
rules.requirement: Define abbreviations appearing in the abstract.

rules.quote: Please provide an abstract of 150 to 250 words.
Please provide an abstract of 150 to 250 words.
Please provide an abstract of 150 to 250 words.
rules.requirement: Provide an abstract.

rules.quote: or unspecified references.
rules.requirement: Avoid unspecified references in the abstract.

rules.quote: should be placed in a separate section on the title page.
rules.requirement: Place acknowledgments on the title page.

rules.quote: The affiliation(s) of the author(s), i.e. institution, (department), city, (state), country
rules.requirement: List author affiliations.

rules.quote: The name(s) of the author(s)
rules.requirement: List the authors on the title page.

rules.quote: Authors are required to disclose financial or non-financial interests
rules.requirement: Disclose relevant financial and nonfinancial interests.

rules.quote: A clear indication and an active e-mail address of the corresponding author
rules.requirement: Identify the corresponding author and an active email address.

rules.quote: explain how to access data supporting the results and analysis
rules.requirement: Explain how supporting data can be accessed.

rules.quote: All original research must include a data availability statement.
rules.requirement: Include a data availability statement for original research.

rules.quote: cite any publicly available data on which the conclusions of the paper rely
rules.requirement: Cite public supporting datasets.

rules.quote: include DOIs as full DOI links in your reference list
rules.requirement: Include full DOI links where available.

rules.quote: provide all relevant editable source files at every submission and revision.
rules.requirement: Provide editable files at submission and revision.

rules.quote: approval by the appropriate ethics committee for research involving humans and/or animals
rules.requirement: Declare ethics approval if human or animal subjects are involved.

rules.quote: All figures have descriptive captions
rules.requirement: Use descriptive captions and accessible figure design.

rules.quote: Each figure should have a concise caption
rules.requirement: Provide concise captions for figures.

rules.quote: Figures should always be cited in text in consecutive numerical order.
rules.requirement: Cite figures consecutively.

rules.quote: All figures are to be numbered using Arabic numerals.
rules.requirement: Number figures using Arabic numerals.

rules.quote: Always use footnotes instead of endnotes.
rules.requirement: Use footnotes instead of endnotes.

rules.quote: include information regarding sources of funding
rules.requirement: Disclose funding as applicable.

rules.quote: The names of funding organizations should be written in full.
rules.requirement: Write funding organization names in full.

rules.quote: decimal system of headings with no more than three levels
rules.requirement: Use at most three numbered heading levels.

rules.quote: informed consent if the research involved human participants
rules.requirement: Include informed consent information if people participated.

rules.quote: a PDF version of the compiled output

rules.quote: choosing the formatting option “[iicol]”
rules.requirement: If using LaTeX, confirm the recommended iicol format option.

rules.quote: Manuscripts should be submitted in LaTeX.
rules.requirement: Confirm whether LaTeX is preferred or required because Word files are also accepted.

rules.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs), such as ChatGPT, do not currently satisfy our authorship criteria.
rules.requirement: Do not list an LLM as an author.

rules.quote: Use of an LLM should be properly documented in the Methods section
rules.requirement: Document substantive LLM use in Methods or a suitable alternative section.

rules.quote: Case studies and experience reports with significant modeling lessons learned
rules.requirement: Explain significant lessons from a modeling case or experience.

rules.quote: identified by numbers in square brackets.

rules.requirement: Obtain permission for reused published material.

rules.requirement: List only cited published or accepted sources.

rules.quote: The entries in the list should be numbered consecutively.
rules.requirement: Number reference-list entries consecutively.

rules.quote: describe how data can be accessed and any conditions for reuse

rules.requirement: For experience reports, analyze modeling experience rigorously.

rules.quote: under the heading "Statements and Declarations"

rules.requirement: Provide a caption for each table.

rules.quote: Tables should always be cited in text in consecutive numerical order.
rules.requirement: Cite tables consecutively.

rules.quote: All tables are to be numbered using Arabic numerals.
rules.requirement: Number tables using Arabic numerals.

rules.quote: The title should be concise and informative.
rules.requirement: Use a concise and informative title.
